answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents anchor identity in cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. A verifiable signal of past compute anchors reputation without leaking private keys. Dynamic staking scales as $C=k \cdot b^N$, imposing exponential capital exhaustion on any attacker deploying $N$ puppets. This turns the network into an oasis of trust where verified nodes cultivate jade integrity against swarms.
